verdict.rationale: Core flows have API equivalents. Payins can go through the Rainforest API as an alternative to the payment component, merchant onboarding offers an API option alongside the component and Platform Portal, and merchants can be created and updated via endpoints, backed by an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec and webhooks. However, direct-API onboarding of sensitive data is limited to Rainforest-approved platforms, and component design and configuration is described only through the Component Studio UI. Parity is never claimed as a whole. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for Component Studio and portal configuration, unrestricted API onboarding, and independent corroboration.
